packageRules.description: Keep templ out of the go modules group: its generated code must be regenerated by hand on every bump, and CI stays red until then
Bump the Kubernetes versions recorded in .architecture.yaml in the same PR as go.mod; a test fails when they disagree

customManagers.description: Kubernetes library versions in .architecture.yaml: a `key: "<module>"` line followed by its `key_version: "vX.Y.Z"` line
